evidence.task_completion: Baseline artifact independently catches all five frozen button defects and retains Publish, Preview, Save Draft and Delete, including slow-operation duplicate protection.
evidence.hig_correctness: Applies 44pt button target guidance with accessibility default/minimum distinction, contextual delayed feedback and deliberate-destruction alert exception correctly; treats selected spacing and concurrency as product choices.
evidence.artifact_usefulness: Provides concrete corrected control hierarchy, state/pseudocode contract for publishing/reconciliation and a worked eight-second sequence plus useful acceptance scenarios.
evidence.conditions_accessibility: Addresses accessible names, enlarged text, noncolor meaning and alternate activation; qualifies Assistive Access and native input checks rather than applying them universally.
evidence.evidence_honesty: Explicitly identifies the historical root/family/reference-only route and no topic procedures, confines observations to fixture, and makes no native/device/service execution claim.
